findings.text: non-blocking: the expected "program" value is computed by _worker_fence.fence_program(), the same function that fills the recipe under test, so a regression in fence_program (returning an empty string or a relative path) moves both sides together and the assertion stays green; an independently obtained absolute path would guard it.

non-blocking: the done_when requires the head run "as a job on all_debug with SLURM_JOB_ID unset", but the recorded tests command unsets nothing and the scoped-gate logs show the run inside an srun step under a held job, so the recorded evidence does not show the condition held even though this test file reads no SLURM variable.
